case.question: GS10 drive is running at full nameplate speed but will not respond to speed command changes. What are the top two causes to verify?

key_points: Verify parameter P00.20 (Master Frequency Command Source) is set to the correct input source (0=Digital keypad, 1=RS-485 communication, 2=External analog input)
Check that the speed reference input (analog or digital terminal) is actually changing and is wired correctly per the manual's wiring diagram
If using terminal inputs, verify the terminal block connector is fully seated and the input signal is present with a voltmeter
Review the Speed Reference Control chart to ensure the correct parameter settings for the input source in use
wrong_if: Assumes the motor speed feedback is not working without checking command source first
States that speed commands are only via analog 0-10V input on GS10
Recommends resetting all drive parameters before checking the control wiring
Claims the drive display showing 'RUN' means the speed control input is working

turns.question: GS10 drive is running at full nameplate speed but will not respond to speed command changes. What are the top two causes to verify?
turns.answer:
1. Verify that the active Speed Reference parameter (e.g., Speed Reference 1 P047, Speed Reference 2 P048, Speed Reference 3 P049) is set to the source you intend to use, because if the drive is using a different speed reference than the one you’re commanding, speed changes will be ignored [7].

2. Verify the Start Source parameter (P046) is configured for keypad or external command as required; an incorrect start source will prevent the drive from accepting new speed commands [7].
